events.title: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 is now generally available
events.summary: GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES) 3.22 is now available and introduces new capabilities across the platform. Here are a few highlights in the 3.22 release: Enterprise teams, previously in public preview, is now generally available. Enterprise owners can use enterprise teams to manage users and their access across the entire enterprise, including organizations and repositories, from a single, centralized team structure.
